status: Provisional relative pattern for paper verification only
method: Measure the narrow smooth shafts below the original screw-in magnetic discs. Centre spacing = (mean outside span + mean inside gap) / 2. If inside jaws cannot reach: mean outside span minus half the sum of the two individual shaft diameters.
excluded: Earlier analog trials; invalid D inside measurements; unresolved first C inside reading
orientation: Owner sketch IDs, not uniform coordinates. Match to actual panel and connector orientation before enclosure coordinates are assigned.

B.confidence: First inside reading confirmed; remaining digits transcribed from private sheet and visually reviewed, not individually text-confirmed

C.confidence: Photo transcription, provisional; first inside reading unresolved and excluded. Control only; template uses G via C = G.

D.confidence: User-confirmed outside readings and unequal shaft diameters; inside jaws could not reach

G.confidence: Single confirmed outside reading, same two measured feet

H.confidence: Single confirmed outside reading, same two measured feet; control only, template uses D via H = D

outside_only_controls.note: Single controls initially mislabeled G/H, corrected by owner to F/E. No centre spacing independently derived.

template_assumptions: User-confirmed provisional pairings: H = D, G = C, F = A, E = B
Straight parallel outer columns and straight parallel top/bottom rows; eight holes, no centre hole
Top and bottom intermediate holes stagger oppositely; not centred
Origin is hole (0,0), not panel corner. No accurate edge offsets collected.
Foot-shaft coaxiality and jaw alignment unverified; decimals are calculation precision, not certified tolerance
